answer: The registry accepts a Telegram account link only through a fresh-nonce signature. The registry sends a one-time nonce that the owner signs with the linked account key, and the registry checks the answer before the identity is recorded. The wander that seals the link is the verified response; a gale of doubt reopens the check, and a shale of failed answers bars the claim, so an agent cannot register a Telegram account belonging to someone else.
